entity.name: resource
entity.deltaImportQuery: select * from evladmin.evolve_resource where resource_type_id=5 and RESOURCE_ID='${dataimporter.delta.RESOURCE_ID}'
entity.deltaQuery: select RESOURCE_ID from evladmin.base_product_resource where update_date > to_date('${dataimporter.last_index_time}','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

entity.name: base_product_resource
entity.query: select ppm_price,ppm_price_cad,(case when ppm_price is not null then ppm_price else price end) as price,product_type_id,TO_CHAR(pub_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd"T"hh24:mi:ss"Z"') as PUB_DATE,pub_status_id,copyright_year,edition_number, sbu_code,profit_center_code,major_subject_code,archived from evladmin.base_product_resource where resource_id='${resource.RESOURCE_ID}'

entity.name: disciplineSpeciality
entity.query: select t.discipline_id as DISCIPLINE_ID,t.specialty_id as SPECIALTY_ID from evladmin.disc_spec_peak_taxonomy t,evladmin.smart_taxonomy_sbu_pc_msc st where t.taxonomy_id = st.taxonomy_id and st.sbu_code = '${base_product_resource.SBU_CODE}' and st.profit_center_code = '${base_product_resource.PROFIT_CENTER_CODE}' and st.major_subject_code = '${base_product_resource.MAJOR_SUBJECT_CODE}'

entity.name: programTaxonomy
entity.query: select t.program_category_id as PROGRAM_CATEGORY_ID,t.program_sub_category_id as PROGRAM_SUB_CATEGORY_ID from evladmin.program_category_taxonomy t,evladmin.smart_taxonomy_sbu_pc_msc st where t.taxonomy_id = st.taxonomy_id and st.sbu_code = '${base_product_resource.SBU_CODE}' and st.profit_center_code = '${base_product_resource.PROFIT_CENTER_CODE}' and st.major_subject_code = '${base_product_resource.MAJOR_SUBJECT_CODE}'

entity.name: related_product_resource_details
entity.query: select distinct e.RESOURCE_KEY as RESOURCE_KEY,e.name as NAME, rt.resource_type_key as RESOURCE_TYPE_KEY,pt.product_type_key as PRODUCT_TYPE_KEY,pt.catalog_product_type_key as CATALOG_PRODUCT_TYPE_KEY,bpr.edition_number as EDITION_NUMBER, bpr.copyright_year as COPYRIGHT_YEAR,bpr.ppm_price as PPM_PRICE, bpr.ppm_price_cad as PPM_PRICE_CAD, bpr.price as PRICE,pt.relevancy as RELEVANCY,er1.role_id as ROLE from evladmin.evolve_resource e,evladmin.related_product p ,evladmin.resource_type rt,evladmin.BASE_PRODUCT_RESOURCE bpr, evladmin.product_type pt, evladmin.product_resource pr,evladmin.evolve_resource er1 where e.resource_id=p.related_resource_id and bpr.resource_id=p.related_resource_id and pr.base_product_resource_id = p.related_resource_id and er1.resource_id = pr.resource_id and relationship_type_id IN (1,2) and bpr.pub_status_id not in (1,7) and (bpr.archived is null or bpr.archived = 'N') and e.resource_type_id = rt.resource_type_id and pt.product_type_id = bpr.product_type_id and p.resource_id='${resource.RESOURCE_ID}' and pr.include_in_search_flag ='Y' and er1.published_flag='Y' order by pt.relevancy desc,pt.product_type_key,bpr.copyright_year desc

entity.name: isbnJsonData
entity.query: select jd.large_string_value from evladmin.json_data jd where jd.resource_id = '${resource.RESOURCE_ID}' and jd.name='isbn10'

entity.name: contactOriginJsonData
entity.query: select jd.large_string_value from evladmin.json_data jd where jd.resource_id = '${resource.RESOURCE_ID}' and jd.name='contactOrigin'

entity.name: ancillaryJSONdata
entity.query: select jd.large_string_value from evladmin.json_data jd where jd.resource_id = '${resource.RESOURCE_ID}' and jd.name ='ancillary'

entity.name: coreProductJsonData
entity.query: select jd.large_string_value from evladmin.json_data jd where jd.resource_id = '${resource.RESOURCE_ID}' and jd.name ='coreProductFlag'

entity.name: product_type
entity.query: select product_type_key,name,category,${base_product_resource.listPrice} as ORIGINAL_PRICE,${base_product_resource.listPriceCAD} as ORIGINAL_PRICE_CAD,product_type_id,eflag,relevancy from evladmin.product_type where product_type_id='${base_product_resource.PRODUCT_TYPE_ID}'

entity.name: authors
entity.query: select first_name,last_name, degree_letters from evladmin.author where resource_id=${resource.RESOURCE_ID} order by display_order asc

entity.name: facultyProduct
entity.query: select e.RESOURCE_ID as FACULTY_ID,p.include_in_search_flag as SEARCH_FLAG,p.marketing_url,lower(r.name) as ROLE_NAME, e.published_flag as PUB_FLAG from evladmin.evolve_resource e,evladmin.product_resource p,evladmin.role r where e.resource_id=p.resource_id and r.role_id=e.role_id and r.role_id=6 and p.base_product_resource_id= '${resource.RESOURCE_ID}' and e.published_flag='Y'

entity.name: jsonData
entity.query: select large_string_value from evladmin.json_data where resource_id='${facultyProduct.FACULTY_ID}' and name='platforms'

entity.name: jsonData
entity.query: select jd.large_string_value from evladmin.json_data jd where jd.resource_id='${facultyProduct.FACULTY_ID}' and jd.name='sites'

entity.name: studentProduct
entity.query: select e.RESOURCE_ID as STUDENT_ID,p.include_in_search_flag as SEARCH_FLAG,p.marketing_url,lower(r.name) as ROLE_NAME , e.published_flag as PUB_FLAG from evladmin.evolve_resource e,evladmin.product_resource p,evladmin.role r where e.resource_id=p.resource_id and r.role_id=e.role_id and r.role_id=5 and p.base_product_resource_id= '${resource.RESOURCE_ID}' and e.published_flag='Y'

entity.name: jsonData
entity.query: select jd.large_string_value from evladmin.json_data jd where jd.resource_id='${studentProduct.STUDENT_ID}' and jd.name='sites'

entity.name: studentAdminData
entity.query: select to_char(update_date,'MM/DD/YY') as UPDATE_DATE,update_by,published_flag from evladmin.evolve_resource where resource_key='${resource.RESOURCE_KEY}' and role_id=6

entity.name: facultyAdminData
entity.query: select to_char(update_date,'MM/DD/YY') as UPDATE_DATE,update_by,published_flag from evladmin.evolve_resource where resource_key='${resource.RESOURCE_KEY}' and role_id=5
